description: React component for a button that handles embedded app binding actions in Mattermost, including click handling, context creation, and rendering with loading state.

classes.name: ButtonBinding
classes.description: React component for a button that triggers app binding actions, manages loading state, and renders label with Markdown.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component state with executing set to false.

methods.name: handleClick
methods.description: Handles button click: fetches channel info, creates call context, invokes binding click handler, and processes response types including showing ephemeral messages or opening modals.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a button with a loading wrapper and Markdown label if binding has submit or form source; otherwise returns null.
